summary: End-to-end ML platforms provide integrated infrastructure for training, fine-tuning, experiment tracking, deployment, and governance of models at scale, bundling compute orchestration, feature stores, model registries, and monitoring into a single managed environment. You need a full platform when you are building or heavily customizing your own models, managing many experiments and teams, or require reproducibility, lineage, and governance at enterprise scale; if you only need to call a pre-trained foundation model for inference, a hosted model API (OpenAI, Anthropic, Bedrock) is far simpler and cheaper. The market is led by the hyperscaler platforms (SageMaker, Vertex AI, Azure ML) and Databricks, with specialized MLOps and AutoML tools filling niches around tracking, automation, and serverless compute.

platforms.name: AWS SageMaker
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go based on compute instance hours, storage, and endpoint usage; no upfront fees.
platforms.best_for: AWS-native teams developing and deploying custom models with deep integration into the AWS ecosystem.

platforms.name: Google Vertex AI
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute/node hours, training, prediction, and generative AI token usage.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting highly automated, state-of-the-art ML pipelines and strong AutoML/GenAI on Google Cloud.

platforms.name: Azure Machine Learning
platforms.pricing: Pay-as-you-go by compute instance hours plus storage; no surcharge on top of underlying Azure resources.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises in the Microsoft ecosystem needing governance, responsible AI, and Azure OpenAI integration.

platforms.name: Databricks (MLflow + Mosaic AI)
platforms.pricing: Consumption-based pricing via Databricks Units (DBUs) plus underlying cloud compute.
platforms.best_for: Collaborative data science and heavy data engineering/ETL with a unified lakehouse across multiple clouds.

platforms.name: MLflow
platforms.pricing: Free and open source; costs only for self-hosted infrastructure or managed hosting.
platforms.best_for: Teams wanting an open-source, framework-agnostic standard for experiment tracking and model lifecycle management.

platforms.name: Weights & Biases
platforms.pricing: Free tier for individuals; subscription tiers by user/seat and tracked usage for teams and enterprise.
platforms.best_for: ML research and engineering teams needing best-in-class experiment tracking and visualization across any framework.

platforms.name: DataRobot
platforms.pricing: Enterprise subscription/licensing (custom quote) based on usage and deployments.
platforms.best_for: Enterprises and business analysts wanting automated model building and governance with minimal coding.

platforms.name: H2O.ai
platforms.pricing: Open-source core free; enterprise AutoML and generative AI products via commercial subscription.
platforms.best_for: Organizations needing open-source-friendly AutoML and explainable AI across cloud and on-prem.

platforms.name: Modal
platforms.pricing: Usage-based per-second billing for CPU/GPU compute; free starter credits.
platforms.best_for: Developers wanting serverless, code-first GPU compute for training and deploying models without managing infrastructure.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.cloud: Cloud-agnostic (SaaS + integrations with AWS, Azure, GCP)
platforms.pricing: Free tier for open models; paid Inference Endpoints by compute hour, plus Pro and Enterprise subscriptions.
platforms.best_for: Teams building on open-source transformers and foundation models needing hosting, fine-tuning, and sharing.
